description: Implement a single task from a Rust `implementation_plan.md`-style task list — just the implementation and its tests — in any Cargo package or workspace: an agent-friendly command-line tool scaffolded by `iru-setup-rust-cli` (logic in `src/lib.rs`, thin `src/main.rs`, clap 4, optional Ratatui UI, `tests/cli.rs`, `xtask/`) or any other Rust library, service or CLI. Detects at runtime, from `cargo metadata` and the manifests, the workspace vs. single-crate layout, lib/bin targets, edition and `rust-version` (MSRV), `rust-toolchain.toml`, clap derive vs. builder, ratatui/crossterm, tokio, the test crates (assert_cmd, predicates, snapbox/trycmd, insta, tempfile, testcontainers), the `[lints]`/`clippy.toml`/`rustfmt.toml`/`deny.toml` configuration, an `xtask` member, and whether the project follows the catalog's CLI contract (an exit-code enum mapped to `ExitCode`, `--format`/`--json`, a JSON error envelope) — then loads only the matching guidance from this skill's own `reference/` directory (always: Rust code style — edition 2024 rules, logic in the lib, naming, ownership, the lint set, no new dependencies — and testing — unit tests with injected writers, `assert_cmd` end-to-end tests with a cleared environment that still forwards `LLVM_PROFILE_FILE`, golden JSON, exit-code tables, no-TTY and `NO_COLOR` tests; as needed: error handling with `thiserror` and one failure→exit-code mapping, rustdoc, the shared CLI contract, clap, output/colour/prompts/signals/broken pipe, Ratatui with `TestBackend`, the catalog's UI contract on Ratatui when a task touches the terminal UI — `Widget` components, `Action` events, lists rendering only the visible window, state × direction × theme UI tests captured as `.txt` into `.ui-screenshots/`, asserted accessibility checks at the `.ui-quality.yml` level —, security — argv-only processes, path canonicalization, redacted secrets, `unsafe_code = "forbid"` — and async/tokio only when the project already uses it). Re-checks the current code state, implements exactly what the task specifies, writes/updates its tests, formats only its own files with rustfmt, compile-checks with `cargo check --all-targets --locked` (plus `--all-features` when the package has features), then — if the task didn't stop on a blocker — immediately checks off this task's own checkbox (and its sub-tasks') in `implementation_plan.md` with a "group validation pending" note, before handing back a short summary. Does not run tests, clippy, coverage, `cargo deny`, `cargo doc`, or license-header checks — those happen once per task group in `iru-rust-code-one-task-group`, which invokes this skill once per task (in parallel when the group allows it, through `iru-isolated-skill-executor`). Invoke as `/iru-rust-code-one-task <task description>`, passing the task's own text — including its exact `implementation_plan.md` checkbox line(s) — as the argument. The coding skill for plan tasks tagged `rust`.
